item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po'i 'phyong las srung ba g.yung drung gur khang nga drung gur khang
item.coloph: 'di 'dra'i gdams pa khyad par can/ 'jig rten gsum na dkon mod cing / rgyal khams 'grims kyang rnyed med pas/ stag la me 'bar thugs kyi bcud/ lha klu mi gsum bsgrags pa'i bon/ snang mdog gshen la dbang bskur bas/ lho yi gshen po gsum la gdams/ de nas zhang zhung gshen gyi thugs bcud/ dran pa nam mkha' khyod la gdams/ zhes gsungs nas/ dpon gsas da mi thad kes/ dran pa nam mkha' la gdams pa'o/ u ya/ des las ldan kyi gshen blo ldan snying po la brgyud pa'o//
